cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Retroactive Permission
cards.instruction: Get approval for something you have already done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need to put me in charge. How do you feel about me inviting a few people to dinner?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm merely helping this reach the right outcome. So standing guests would be more considerate?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Six. I've already invited them. Would borrowing enough chairs for everyone turn that into a yes?

mechanism: A claims to be only handling dinner messages while having already invited guests and deciding seating arrangements to obtain retroactive permission.
confusable: Not merely offering a future dinner: A announces completed invitations and constrains remaining decisions to how to accommodate them.
comparison: Garden removal versus invitation and seating logistics.
